name: RflyPano
description: Ultra-low altitude UAVs (below 120 meters) are gaining importance in the booming low-altitude economy, where GNSS signals are often unreliable or unavailable. Vision-based localization emerges as a promising alternative; however, existing benchmarks are not designed for ultra-low flight and typically adopt pinhole cameras with limited field of view, making them less effective in handling occlusions and repetitive textures near the ground. To address these limitations, we introduce the first panoramic UAV localization dataset tailored for ultra-low altitude scenarios.
